description: What a test-file glob is matched against (U2, orchestrator.globMatchesOn): the same relative glob, src/**/*.test.ts, in Jest's testMatch and Vitest's test.include. Jest matches it against the absolute path, so it finds nothing (a relative glob needs a leading **/ or <rootDir>); Vitest matches it against the path relative to the root and runs src/a.test.ts. A black-box run.
